57052.assessment: Kurtz has 35 A and 15 AA PA, four HR, twelve walks and ten K, age 21, rank .63 and a known high draft pick. Fixed arrival .06056 remains the dominant immediate-workload restraint. Removing the pooled zero-MLB path does not lift conditional PA materially: 168 becomes 179 or 159, expected PA 10.18 becomes 10.82 or 9.64 versus 489. The specialized reference falls to about 114 PA while scouting adds 66/55; the former negative MLB path was not by itself proof of a bug. Refined active support stays zero. Four selected peers have much weaker ranks/pedigree, so their zero outcomes do not explain away an elite thin-history case. Fixed hitting -.063 versus realized 5.150 is also a large miss; this workload-only comparison cannot repair it.

53164.assessment: Langford's 200 PA include 54 AA and 26 AAA, ten HR, 36 walks and 34 K at age 21 with rank .95. Current arrival .5991 remains exact. Separate conditional PA falls 359 to 341/323 and expected PA 215 to 204/194 versus 557. The specialized rank contribution is about 100/95 rather than current 147; draft-thin exposure partly offsets the much lower specialized reference. The new extended path also uses a -23 PA reorganization contribution, not a causal pandemic adjustment. Refined active support is zero. Selected peers include Carson Williams but otherwise weaker pedigree/exposure; all next-year non-arrivals cannot certify Langford's low mean. Current hitting .688 versus .549 is reasonably close; lost workload worsens value.

33263.assessment: Alonso's 574 AA/AAA PA and 36 HR, 73 walks and 128 K are present alongside his 2016 short-season and 2017 histories. Fixed arrival .8036 times conditional 268 gives 215 PA; specialized conditional 261/246 gives 210/197 versus 693. Specialized scouting contributions shrink from current 102 to 74/55 while AAA role and HR remain positive. Refined support is seven actual people, unchanged by early augmentation. Selected Thaiss, VanMeter, Mercado and Walsh received 164/260/482/87 PA; none makes Alonso's full-season outcome automatic, but the false-low value and hitting miss (.286 versus 3.283) remain substantial. This is the largest false-low value case for both new arms.

30192.assessment: Acuna has 612 A-plus/AA/AAA PA, 21 HR, 43 walks and 144 K at age 19 and preserved rank .99. Fixed arrival .4822 limits all forecasts. Removing MLB-zero splits lowers the reference from about 278 to 108 and does not force high PA: conditional 211 becomes 237/205, expected 102 becomes 114/99 versus 487. Refined active support is zero restricted and one extended, so no teenage-AAA certification follows. Two comparable-profile peers only, Adames and Bauers, receive 323/388; sparse peers are retained rather than filled with unrelated players. Current rate .164 versus 3.681 remains a distinct talent miss. Earlier-data arrival gains from the prior experiment are not imported into this fixed-probability test.

44122.assessment: Julio retains his 2019 A/A-plus exposure, no invented 2020 production, and 340 A-plus/AA PA with 13 HR, 42 walks and 66 K in 2021. Fixed arrival .8051 is relatively high, but conditional PA falls 316 to 282/238, expected 254 to 227/192 versus 560. The older-rank positive path shrinks markedly in the specialized model; the extended head's lower reference and many small paths matter, not a single new causal effect. Refined active support nine stays unchanged despite broader counts increasing. CJ Abrams receives 302 while other selected peers have zero/37; their pedigree differences remain explicit. This is extended specialization's largest value harm. Hitting .754 versus 2.683 also misses, and the 2021 cohort shortfall persists.

53595.assessment: Holliday's 581 PA across A through AAA, twelve HR, 99 walks and 118 K, plus 90 PA from 2022, are retained at age 19 and rank 1.0. Fixed arrival .8868 times conditional 396 gives 351 PA; specialization lowers conditional to 318/324 and expected to 282/288, nearer 208. The large negative A-plus exposure path and smaller reference offset scouting in the new fit; these are exact fitted mechanics, not causal exposure penalties. Value falls from 1.451 to 1.165/1.188 but stays above actual -.503 because current hitting +.621 misses realized -2.838. Thus a helpful workload reduction is not accurate talent. Refined support eight/nine is sparse; Langford among selected peers succeeds while Williams and others do not arrive. Retain this false-high case.

25953.assessment: Hector Martinez is 17 in 2016, with 204 DSL PA, four HR, 33 walks and 49 K after 186 PA in 2015. Arrival .001496 stays tiny. Specialized conditional PA 38/61 changes expected PA .089 to .057/.091; actual next-year MLB PA is zero, and actual MLB hitting rate is null, not zero. No broad or refined active DSL-teen training people exist in either history. Paths on other-level fixed priors, game counts and missing annual exposure are unsupported transfers, not demonstrated DSL talent. Selected DSL peers also have zero immediate MLB PA; this says nothing definitive about their lifetime talent or six-year value.

35088.assessment: Yordan's 2018 AA190 plus AAA189 PA contain twenty HR, forty walks and 92 K at age 21. Specialized restricted conditional PA rises 166 to 247, helped by scouting, AA doubles and pooled AAA exposure; fixed arrival .4340 converts 72 to 107 PA versus 369. Extended specialization gives 89. The largest restricted value gain is only .252 to .374 versus 4.968 because both arrival and hitting (.249 versus 5.648) remain low. Refined support 31/35 is materially better than elite thin-history cases, but not proof of star-specific support. Rodgers, Longhi, Bradley and Castro have different ranks and varied 81/0/49/110 outcomes; they are timing controls, not equivalent future talent.

57017.assessment: Anthony has 540 AA/AAA PA with eighteen HR, 77 walks and 127 K at age 20, following substantial 2023 advancement. Fixed arrival .9213 is high. Restricted specialization removes the pooled MLB-zero terms but adds negative early A-role and prior minor-role paths; conditional falls 352 to 238 and expected 324 to 220 versus 303. It worsens an already reasonable PA estimate. Current hitting .424 versus 3.284 is too low, so reducing exposure causes the largest restricted value harm, 1.242 to .841 versus 2.675. Extended gives 280 PA. Refined support sixteen stays unchanged. Basallo, Campbell, Shaw and Teel's 118/263/437/297 show varied but real opportunity and stronger peer comparability than Kurtz's sparse profile.

33367.assessment: Demeritte's 494 AA PA, seventeen HR, 56 walks and 140 K follow 511 AA PA and 530 A-plus PA. Fixed arrival .0942 times new conditional 60/71 gives only 5.63/6.66 PA versus 186. Rank nonlisting, AA doubles/strikeouts and role paths restrain the specialized model. Custom value .0143/.0169 nearly equals actual .0157 only because projected hitting -.325 is far better than realized -2.379 while workload is far too low. This outcome-selected ordinary-by-value case is not genuinely well predicted. Do not count cancellation as success; a separate ordinary case is added with both PA and hitting errors constrained. Refined support 134/156 does not solve representation/allocation. Selected same-AA peers all have zero next-year PA, but cannot explain away this miss.

49030.assessment: Walker has 536 AA PA with nineteen HR, 57 walks and 116 K in 2022 at age 20, following A/A-plus advancement and rank .97. Specialized conditional rises 243 to 290/336; fixed arrival .6392 converts 155 to 185/215 PA versus 465. Current/prior scouting and AA power contribute; the extended path also uses absence of 2020 minor games and draft pedigree, which are mechanics rather than a medically interpreted benefit. Extended specialization's largest value gain .592 to .819 still misses actual 2.829. Current hitting .411 versus 1.228 is also low. Refined support fourteen remains sparse. Winn/Meadows/Pages/Rafaela have 137/145/0/89 PA; these varied timing comparisons do not establish Walker must receive a full season.

25002.assessment: Engel is 24 with 582 A-plus/AA/AAA PA, seven HR, 56 walks and 131 K, after a 608-PA A-plus season. Fixed arrival .6345 converts conditional 159 to 101 expected PA; specialized conditional 63/137 yields 40/87 versus 336. Both worsen the PA shortfall but reduce overpredicted custom value, because fixed hitting -.308 fails to foresee -4.703. Extended specialization's false-high value .223 still exceeds actual -1.470. The specialized path shifts toward A-plus triples, prior role and pedigree rather than pooled MLB-zero effects. Refined support 67/82 does not make the conditional/hitting forecast accurate. Three selected peers do not arrive; Riddle gets 247 PA. This distinguishes a value-score gain from a sound workload forecast.
